title: WorkflowRunRootBinding
description: Immutable single-assignment binding created only after the root AgentRun and RunManifest are admitted.
x-semantic-constraints: binding_digest is RFC 8785 JCS SHA-256 over the binding excluding binding_digest
workflow_run_id is unique and the referenced AgentRun is the only root Run in the same Tenant and WorkOrder
the RootBinding, root AgentRun and RunManifest are inserted atomically with deferred foreign-key validation; a failed pre-admission WorkflowRun has no RootBinding
